question: top 3 dropoff zones per pickup zone with trip counts
sql: WITH route_counts AS (SELECT PULocationID, DOLocationID, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM nyc_taxi_trips GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID ORDER BY trips DESC, DOLocationID) AS rn FROM route_counts) SELECT PULocationID, list(struct_pack(dropoff_zone := DOLocationID, trips := trips) ORDER BY trips DESC) AS top_dropoffs, SUM(trips) AS total_trips FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY PULocationID ORDER BY total_trips DESC LIMIT 20;

question: zones with multiple payment types, exploded payment type tip stats
sql: WITH zone_payments AS (SELECT PULocationID, list(DISTINCT payment_type) AS payment_types, COUNT(*) AS trips, AVG(tip_amount) AS avg_tip FROM nyc_taxi_trips GROUP BY PULocationID) SELECT PULocationID, UNNEST(payment_types) AS payment_type, trips, avg_tip FROM zone_payments WHERE list_length(payment_types) > 1 ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 30;

question: trips tip over 20% fare, JSON fare breakdown
sql: WITH trip_json AS (SELECT PULocationID, DOLocationID, to_json(struct_pack(fare := fare_amount, tip := tip_amount, tip_pct := CASE WHEN fare_amount > 0 THEN tip_amount / fare_amount ELSE NULL END, extras := list_value(extra, mta_tax, tolls_amount, congestion_surcharge))) AS attributes FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE fare_amount > 0) SELECT PULocationID, DOLocationID, CAST(json_extract(attributes, '$.tip_pct') AS DOUBLE) AS tip_pct, attributes FROM trip_json WHERE CAST(json_extract(attributes, '$.tip_pct') AS DOUBLE) > 0.2 ORDER BY tip_pct DESC LIMIT 20;

question: passenger count mix per pickup zone as struct list
sql: WITH mix AS (SELECT PULocationID, passenger_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE passenger_count BETWEEN 0 AND 8 GROUP BY PULocationID, passenger_count) SELECT PULocationID, list(struct_pack(passengers := passenger_count, trips := cnt) ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS passenger_mix, SUM(cnt) AS total_trips FROM mix GROUP BY PULocationID ORDER BY total_trips DESC LIMIT 20;

question: top 5 longest trips per pickup zone, distance and dropoff zone
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT PULocationID, DOLocationID, trip_distance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID ORDER BY trip_distance DESC, DOLocationID) AS rn FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE trip_distance > 0) SELECT PULocationID, list(struct_pack(dropoff_zone := DOLocationID, distance := trip_distance) ORDER BY trip_distance DESC) AS longest_trips FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5 GROUP BY PULocationID ORDER BY PULocationID LIMIT 20;

question: hourly trip profile per pickup zone, top hours first
sql: WITH hourly AS (SELECT PULocationID, EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS trips, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_total FROM nyc_taxi_trips GROUP BY PULocationID, hour) SELECT PULocationID, list(struct_pack(hour := hour, trips := trips, avg_total := avg_total) ORDER BY trips DESC) AS hourly_profile, SUM(trips) AS total_trips FROM hourly GROUP BY PULocationID ORDER BY total_trips DESC LIMIT 20;
